title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28
lineage: Uher mic > Uher 4000 Report L 5in reels > MacIntosh pre-amp > TEAC 1230 7in reel

ai_review.summary: A historically significant, audience‑sourced recording of a massive 600 k crowd show that delivers decent sound and moments of strong playing despite mixed performance impressions.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an epic, high‑attendance concert that many fans recall as memorable, with highlights like a Dark Star into The Other One and an emotional encore. Audio quality is uneven – recorded on a primitive tape deck with crowd ambience and occasional muddiness – but it remains a valuable artifact of the era.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews show a wide spread (1‑5 stars) with an average around 3.5; performance comments are split between praise and criticism, while recording quality is described as mediocre to surprisingly good, yielding a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded on a cheap tape deck; sound is muddy/mediocre at times but captures crowd ambience. Not as crisp as board recordings, yet surprisingly listenable for an audience tape of the era.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans note the show was a massive endurance test with a huge crowd; some describe the performance as insipid, others recall superb playing and historic moments.
